### Add packages here { in the combine function, as strings }

```{r}
# short block to check if the packages are installed; will download and install any that are not.4
# ex: c("lpsolveapi", "mlbench")

packages <- c()

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
resort <- read.csv("Dataset/H1.csv", na.strings = "NULL", strip.white = TRUE)
city   <- read.csv("Dataset/H2.csv", na.strings = "NULL", strip.white = TRUE)

resort$Hotel <- "Resort"
city$Hotel   <- "City"

hotels <- rbind(resort, city)

colnames(hotels)
dim(hotels) 
```
